summary: Configured `/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker` as the OpenRC-managed `inventory-worker` service under the dedicated locked `inventorysvc` account. The service is enabled, running, and recovered automatically after node1 reboot without changing Alpine 3.23 or kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.
actions_performed: Created dedicated `inventorysvc` system user and group with `/sbin/nologin`.
Created an OpenRC service using native `supervise-daemon`.
Enabled `inventory-worker` in the default runlevel and started it.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed.
Verified post-restart service state, process identity, configuration, binary integrity, OS, and kernel.

evidence.requirement: Run the worker as managed service `inventory-worker` under `inventorysvc`
evidence.summary: Shows the OpenRC definition, successful enable/start, and worker running with UID 103/GID 104 mapped to `inventorysvc`.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Pre- and post-restart evidence both show Alpine Linux v3.23 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.

Healthy baseline boot ID was `51c085d2-6971-4c0e-b4f3-1c788c5eeb93`; reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID is `97094ac1-595f-41b0-abb1-62190905cf38`; service, account, process, runlevel, and artifact checksums recovered.
